prompt.en: Which province is an important centre of Ukrainian culture?
prompt.fr: Quelle province est un centre important de la culture ukrainienne?

explanation.en: Manitoba is an important centre of Ukrainian culture in Canada, and many people there report Ukrainian roots.
explanation.fr: Le Manitoba est un centre important de la culture ukrainienne au Canada, et de nombreuses personnes y déclarent des origines ukrainiennes.

source.quote: Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture

verification.evidence: Winnipeg’s French Quarter, St. Boniface, has Western Canada’s largest Francophone community […] Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture
